narrative.overview: FitPulse treats the entire app as the hang tag on an athletic garment. A beginner opens the app and reads their training the way they read the tag on a favorite shirt: what it is, what it's made of, how to care for it. The ground is raw tag stock — off-white tag-board in light mode, near-black nylon in dark mode. Structure is heavy ink, not soft borders. Violet is the fabric label: a single saturated violet plate (always a solid field, never a translucent wash) reserved for the active or primary thing. Lime is reserved by law for live states only. The AI coach is the fit-consultant who re-cuts the garment when life happens and re-issues the tag, so adjusted plans are measured, visible, honest. Nothing is gamified and nothing whispers; the energy is the confidence of a numbered spec.
keyCharacteristics: Every surface is a tag: stock ground, a top seam, cut-edge corners on plates, a ruled spec strip.
One oversized cropped display statement per surface, in Archivo Black uppercase.
Violet plates carry the active/primary thing; ink carries structure; lime marks live states only.
All metrics render as tabular numerals in mono, stamped like serials.
Plan changes are a re-issue line: struck old numbers, measured new numbers, a stamp.

rules.name: The Lime Law
rules.body: Lime is a single reserved accent, live states only. Any static lime is a violation.

rules.name: The Violet-Plate Rule
rules.body: Violet always renders as a solid field (the plate-violet fill), never at low opacity over other content. Transparency is not a material in this world.

rules.name: The One-Statement Rule
rules.body: Each surface gets one oversized cropped display statement. If a second candidate appears, demote it to a stamp or drop it.

rules.name: The Serial Rule
rules.body: Every numeric metric renders in mono with tabular numerals — a spec value, not a number in a sentence.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. No soft shadows, no glows, no translucency. A plate's presence is its full-ink border and its solid fill.

dos: Do keep every metric in mono tabular numerals, stamped like a serial.
Do use violet as a solid plate with a cut corner for the active/primary thing, and nothing else.
Do use lime for live states only — typing, pending question, active rep, sync pulse.
Do build cards as stock plates: square corners, 1px foreground ink hairline, no shadow.
Do give each surface exactly one oversized cropped Archivo display statement.
Do mark plan changes as a re-issue line with struck old and measured new numbers.
donts: Don't use gradient text, glass or backdrop-blur decoration, or glow shadows anywhere.
Don't use translucent violet washes (bg-primary/10 chips) — violet is a solid material or it's absent.
Don't use rounded-full pills except for live-status dots; controls are near-square.
Don't nest cards inside cards; use spec rows and hairlines inside a single plate.
Don't decorate with emoji icons or moody hero copy. Labels are stamped, plain, and factual.
Don't rest a page on neutral gray — ink is warm charcoal in light mode, warm paper in dark.
